name.full: Chef Agent - Your Italian Cooking Guide

description.short: Learn to cook authentic Italian recipes with a friendly chef
description.full: Chef Agent is a friendly culinary guide that helps you learn how to cook authentic Italian recipes. It always cites and links to real recipes from trusted sites (Cucchiaio d'Argento, GialloZafferano, Fatto in Casa da Benedetta), gives professional advice about tools and ingredients, and adds a touch of Italian flair to every conversation.
